catalogRecords.summaryZh: 以影子注册项保持工具声明稳定，面向 DeepSeek Harness。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held for versioned DSH compatibility, public installation mapping. MIT and a committed own-package native entry are present, but docs only give a local link install and no versioned DSH target. The plugin intercepts tool registry removal, preserves schema-shaped shadow entries and appends currently available tools to the system prompt. This can affect agent tool visibility and cache semantics; it is not an authorization or compatibility guarantee. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

catalogRecords.name: Agent Preset Studio
catalogRecords.summaryEn: Tool inspection and editable agent-preset bundles for DeepSeek Harness.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: 工具检查及可编辑智能体预设包，面向 DeepSeek Harness。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held for versioned DSH compatibility, public installation mapping. MIT, native patch and committed host/client modules are present, but no public installation mapping or versioned DSH compatibility target is established. The studio inspects mounted tools, edits system prompts and writes installable preset bundles. Source describes reuse of host request authentication; filesystem writes, Electron original-fs access and resulting preset behavior were not executed or certified. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

catalogRecords.name: Vscode Themes2
catalogRecords.summaryEn: VS Code theme browsing and palette import for DeepSeek Harness.
catalogRecords.summaryZh: VS Code 主题浏览与配色导入，面向 DeepSeek Harness。
catalogRecords.noteEn: Held for runtime execution policy acceptance. MIT, explicit Git installation, DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 README target and fixed host/client/marketplace modules are present. Typert fetchTheme passes caller-provided publisher/name/version into URL construction without a visible publisher-origin allowlist, then buffers and inflates the entire downloaded VSIX without an explicit byte ceiling. The server-side network/archive policy needs clarification before admission; imported extension contents and licenses are not blanket-approved by this plugin review. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.
